message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout during dinner, and my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! 😂 My sister started sending funny memes about being cavemen, while I was trying to rally the troops to find the flashlights and power banks. We ended up huddled around my old lantern, playing card games and reminiscing about our last camping trip. It was such a lovely reminder that a little planning (and a good sense of humor) can turn an unexpected moment into a cozy family night. Have you ever had a fun blackout experience?
